events.location: Marathon Soccer Park, Marathon Circle, Austell, GA, USA
events.desc:
The U.S. Open Cup is one of the most prestigious and historic soccer competitions in the United States. First contested in 1914, the tournament brings together clubs from across the American soccer pyramid, creating a unique opportunity for teams to compete on the national stage.

For the first time in our club'\;s history, Swarm FC will enter the competition — and our journey begins right here at home at Marathon Park.
